title.en: Local Web workspace, community plugins and installer-only Windows releases
title.zh: 本机 Web 工作台、社区插件与 Windows 安装包发行

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.8 restores the real local Web workspace with an embedded UI in the CLI, adds community plugin discovery with commit-pinned install previews, and distributes Windows applications through signed x64 and ARM64 installers. Legacy updater metadata is preserved, with native upgrade qualification from the published 0.0.7 installed and portable clients.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.8 恢复连接真实后端的本机 Web 工作台，CLI 内置完整页面；新增社区插件发现和锁定提交的安装预览。Windows 改为仅提供已签名的 x64、ARM64 安装包，保留旧更新清单兼容，并从已发布的 0.0.7 安装版、便携版进行原生升级验收。

title.en: Run the workspace in a local browser
title.zh: 在本机浏览器中运行完整工作台

body.en: Run deepzora web from a project directory. The official CLI embeds the UI, starts a local service on a free loopback port and prints an authenticated access URL. Conversations, streaming, approvals, history and diffs use the same Go application service as Desktop. --dir, --port and --no-open control startup; Node and Electron are not required to run the official CLI package.
body.zh: 在项目目录运行 deepzora web 即可启动本机工作台。官方 CLI 内置页面，在回环地址的空闲端口启动服务并提供带认证的访问链接。对话、流式输出、工具审批、历史记录和差异查看复用桌面端同一套 Go 应用服务；支持 --dir、--port、--no-open，运行官方 CLI 包无需另装 Node 或 Electron。

title.en: Discover plugins and confirm the exact commit to install
title.zh: 发现插件并确认将安装的准确提交

body.en: Settings → Plugins → Discover and deepzora plugin search show community catalog entries, with an optional channel for unreviewed GitHub plugins. Install and update previews bind the package, source, permissions and exact Git commit to a plan ID. Moved tags, withdrawn releases and conflicting local sources cannot silently replace that reviewed plan.
body.zh: 通过“设置 → 插件 → 发现”或 deepzora plugin search 查找社区目录中的插件，也可选择查看未经审核的 GitHub 插件。安装和更新预览以计划 ID 绑定包、来源、权限及准确 Git 提交；标签移动、版本撤回或本地同名来源冲突不会静默替换已确认的计划。

title.en: Filter Magpie models by upstream provider
title.zh: 按上游供应商筛选 Magpie 模型

body.en: The model picker groups Magpie routes under upstream providers such as Ollama Cloud. Identical routes exposed through two Magpie connections remain separate options, retain their connection and send the original routing reference. Existing connection filters and favorites remain available.
body.zh: 模型选择器按 Ollama Cloud 等上游供应商组织 Magpie 路由。两条 Magpie 连接提供相同路由时，仍保留独立选项、原连接及原始路由引用；现有连接筛选与收藏保持可用。

title.en: Windows installers replace the portable application download
title.zh: Windows 统一使用安装包

body.en: Windows x64 and ARM64 applications ship as timestamped Certum Authenticode-signed installers. The website and new release download navigation show installers only. The two legacy Portable.zip names remain as small Minisign-signed archives containing only a migration notice and installer link, so strict older updaters can validate the unchanged eleven-entry matrix. They contain no application.
body.zh: Windows x64、ARM64 应用统一通过带时间戳的 Certum Authenticode 签名安装包发行，官网和新版下载导航只展示安装包。两个旧 Portable.zip 名称保留为很小的 Minisign 签名归档，仅含迁移说明与安装包链接，不含程序；旧更新器仍能校验原有 11 项清单。

title.en: Qualify upgrades with the published old client and update helper
title.zh: 使用真实旧客户端和更新助手验收升级

body.en: Before sealing, the published 0.0.7 installed and portable applications run on native x64 and ARM64 Windows, then their own signed update helper stages, verifies, activates and restarts the exact new installer. Acceptance checks repeated launch, normal exit and retained data. After publication and mirror promotion, the original 0.0.7 updater code checks the live manifest, downloads and verifies the installer and writes its update cache.
body.zh: 封存前，在原生 Windows x64、ARM64 上运行已发布的 0.0.7 安装版和便携版，由它们自带的已签名更新助手验证、暂存、激活并重启本次准确安装包，再验证重复启动、正常退出与数据保留。发布和镜像推进后，还使用原始 0.0.7 更新器代码验证公开清单、安装包下载、签名校验和更新缓存。

title.en: Unattended signing waits for the real login form
title.zh: 无人值守签名等待真实登录表单

body.en: SimplySign automation identifies the native credential controls before sending account information, and restricts popup handling to acknowledgement dialogs. A transient splash window can no longer be selected as the login form. Signer, trust, timestamp and session cleanup checks remain required.
body.zh: SimplySign 自动化在发送账户信息前识别原生输入控件，并只对确认弹窗执行恢复操作，避免把短暂出现的启动画面误当成登录表单；发布者、证书信任、时间戳及会话清理检查保持必需。

title.en: Interrupt idle Unix terminal readers during session cleanup
title.zh: 会话清理时中断 Unix 终端的空闲读取

body.en: Linux and macOS persistent shells register their PTY master for cancellable I/O, so closing a session can interrupt an idle reader even if another process keeps a terminal writer open. Command output, Unicode transport and persistent working-directory state remain covered by regression checks.
body.zh: Linux、macOS 持久化终端将 PTY 主端注册为可取消的 I/O，即使其他进程仍持有终端写入端，关闭会话也能中断空闲读取。命令输出、Unicode 传输及工作目录保持均继续通过回归检查。

title.en: Existing Windows installations keep their automatic update route
title.zh: 现有 Windows 安装保持自动更新路径

body.en: Use the application's normal update action. Existing installed and portable layouts both select Setup.exe; do not install the small compatibility ZIP as an application. Historical 0.0.7 and earlier release files and immutable mirror indexes remain unchanged.
body.zh: 使用应用内正常更新入口即可。现有安装版与便携布局均选择 Setup.exe 更新；不要把纯文本兼容 ZIP 当成应用安装。0.0.7 及更早的历史发布文件和不可变镜像索引保持不变。

title.en: Open the complete URL printed by deepzora web
title.zh: 使用 deepzora web 输出的完整访问链接

body.en: The Web workspace is local-only. A fresh controlling tab replaces the previous connection; closing or refreshing a tab does not cancel accepted work. Native windows, tray, the built-in Electron browser, bots and heartbeat jobs are not started by Web. Update the CLI with deepzora upgrade.
body.zh: Web 工作台仅支持本机访问。新的控制标签页会替换原连接，关闭或刷新标签页不会取消已接受的任务。Web 不启动原生窗口、托盘、Electron 内置浏览器、机器人或心跳任务；通过 deepzora upgrade 更新 CLI。

title.en: Keep shutdown diagnostics if a Windows exit stalls
title.zh: Windows 退出卡住时请保留诊断日志

body.en: Earlier Windows reports included shutdown stopping in cancelling_background. Native upgrade acceptance covers clean hosted systems and does not establish a fix for every production environment. If it recurs, preserve the named shutdown step and service.log/service.log.1 when reporting it.
body.zh: 此前的 Windows 报告包含退出停在 cancelling_background 的情况。原生升级验收覆盖干净的托管系统，并不代表已经修复所有生产环境中的退出问题；如再次出现，请保留报错中的退出步骤名及 service.log、service.log.1 以供定位。

title.en: Signed Windows packages with installer and portable acceptance
title.zh: Windows 签名发行与安装包、便携版验收

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.7 introduces Certum Authenticode signing for Windows x64 and ARM64 desktop installers and the programs inside portable archives. Both final package formats must pass native startup, repeated-launch and normal-exit acceptance before publication.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.7 为 Windows x64、ARM64 桌面安装包和便携版内的程序提供 Certum Authenticode 签名。两种最终发行包均须通过原生启动、重复启动和正常退出验收后才能发布。

title.en: Windows desktop packages identify their publisher
title.zh: Windows 桌面发行包具备发布者签名

body.en: Windows x64 and ARM64 installers and the executable payloads inside their portable ZIPs carry timestamped Certum Authenticode signatures. The portable archives also retain Minisign integrity signatures. Signing is required for this release; unavailable credentials or a failed signature block publication.
body.zh: Windows x64、ARM64 安装包及其便携 ZIP 内的可执行载荷采用带时间戳的 Certum Authenticode 签名，便携归档同时保留 Minisign 完整性签名。本版本要求实际签名，凭据不可用或签名失败均会阻止发布。

title.en: Both Windows download formats receive native acceptance
title.zh: 两种 Windows 下载格式分别进行原生验收

body.en: The exact final installer and portable ZIP each undergo startup, repeated-launch and normal-exit checks on native x64 and ARM64 runners. Installer checks also cover uninstall and user-data retention. Sealed acceptance receipts bind the SHA-256 of both downloads so publication reuses the tested files.
body.zh: 最终安装包和便携 ZIP 分别在原生 x64、ARM64 环境验证启动、重复启动和正常退出；安装包还检查卸载与用户数据保留。封存验收回执同时绑定两种下载文件的 SHA-256，正式发布复用已验收的文件。

title.en: Exit can still stall on some Windows systems
title.zh: 部分 Windows 系统上退出仍可能卡住

body.en: The report of shutdown stopping in cancelling_background ([#126](https://github.com/SivanCola/deepzora/issues/126)) remains unresolved. If it happens, attach service.log and service.log.1 from %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs to that issue; the logs name the stalled step.
body.zh: 退出停在 cancelling_background 的问题（[#126](https://github.com/SivanCola/deepzora/issues/126)）仍未解决。如遇到，请把 %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs 下的 service.log 和 service.log.1 附到该问题；日志会写明卡住的步骤。

title.en: Model display names, Windows title bar and shutdown diagnostics
title.zh: 模型别名、Windows 标题栏与退出诊断

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.6 lets you give a configured model a display name, fixes the Windows window controls showing a mismatched box when the workspace panel is open, and names base theme styles consistently. Shutdown now records each step and reports a stalled one with diagnostics. Desktop moves to Electron 45.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.6 支持为已配置的模型设置别名，修复 Windows 上打开工作区面板时窗口按钮区域颜色不一致的问题，并统一基础主题的名称。退出过程现在会记录每一步，某一步卡住时会输出诊断信息。桌面端升级到 Electron 45。

title.en: Give a model a display name
title.zh: 为模型设置别名

body.en: In Settings → Model services, open a model and enter a display name, for example deepseek-flash for deepseek-flash-1017. The model switcher, the session's model label and the model list show it, with the model ID alongside. Requests, session records and model references keep the model ID, and renaming a model does not restart open sessions.
body.zh: 在“设置 → 模型服务”中打开某个模型并填写别名，例如为 deepseek-flash-1017 填写 deepseek-flash。模型切换器、会话的模型标签和模型列表会显示别名，并在旁边保留模型 ID。请求、会话记录和模型引用仍使用模型 ID，修改别名不会重启已打开的会话。

title.en: Shutdown records its steps and reports a stall
title.zh: 退出过程记录步骤并报告卡住的位置

body.en: Each shutdown step is now written to service.log. A step still running after 10 seconds logs a warning with every goroutine's stack, and the shutdown error names the step, for example stopped in cancelling_background (step …). This makes a stalled exit diagnosable; it does not by itself fix the stall reported in #126.
body.zh: 退出的每一步现在都会写入 service.log。某一步运行超过 10 秒时会记录警告并输出全部协程堆栈，退出失败的提示也会带上具体步骤名，例如 stopped in cancelling_background (step …)。这使卡住的退出可以被定位，但本身并不修复 #126 中报告的卡住问题。

title.en: Electron 45
title.zh: 升级到 Electron 45

body.en: Desktop now runs on Electron 45.2.2 (Chromium 156, Node.js 24.22).
body.zh: 桌面端运行时升级到 Electron 45.2.2（Chromium 156、Node.js 24.22）。

title.en: Windows window controls match the title bar
title.zh: Windows 窗口按钮与标题栏颜色一致

body.en: With the workspace panel open, the minimize, maximize and close buttons no longer sit in a white box beside the grey title bar.
body.zh: 打开右侧工作区面板时，最小化、最大化和关闭按钮不再显示为灰色标题栏旁的白色方块。

title.en: Base theme styles are named consistently
title.zh: 基础主题名称统一

body.en: The theme gallery, theme library and appearance overview now name base styles the same way as the style picker. In Chinese they no longer appear in English; in English the gallery now reads Soft Aurora, Refined, Deep and Soft instead of Aurora, Slate, Carbon and Nocturne.
body.zh: 主题画廊、主题库和外观概览中的基础主题名称现在与样式选择器一致：中文界面不再显示英文名；英文界面的画廊名称由 Aurora、Slate、Carbon、Nocturne 改为 Soft Aurora、Refined、Deep、Soft。

title.en: Windows remains unsigned for this release
title.zh: 本版 Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: The maintainer explicitly approved an unsigned Windows 0.0.6 Stable exception. These files have no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warnings. Minisign integrity signatures, provenance and final-package native acceptance remain mandatory. This approval does not cover prereleases or later versions.
body.zh: 维护者已明确批准 Windows 0.0.6 Stable 未签名发布例外。相关文件没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，Windows 可能显示未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。Minisign 完整性签名、来源验证及最终安装包原生验收仍必须完成。此批准不适用于预发布版或后续版本。

title.en: Exit can still stall on some Windows systems
title.zh: 部分 Windows 系统上退出仍可能卡住

body.en: The report of shutdown stopping in cancelling_background (#126) is not resolved. If it happens, attach service.log and service.log.1 from %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs to #126; this release's logs name the stalled step.
body.zh: 退出停在 cancelling_background 的问题（#126）尚未解决。如遇到，请把 %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs 下的 service.log 和 service.log.1 附到 #126；本版日志会写明卡住的步骤。

title.en: Persistent Teams, connected Bots and safer shutdown
title.zh: 持久化团队、机器人连接与更可靠的退出

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.5 adds local Desktop Teams with persistent members, private and group conversations, shared memory, schedules, member-authorized secrets and usage tracking. Messaging Bots can connect to Team members with replies routed back to their originating conversation. Subagent delegation is simplified, DeepSeek endpoint handling is corrected, and shutdown, credential protection and settings conflict recovery are strengthened.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.5 新增本地桌面团队：持久化成员、私聊与群聊、共享记忆、定时任务、成员授权密钥及用量统计。消息机器人可连接团队成员，回复返回原始消息会话。同时简化子代理委派，修复 DeepSeek 接口地址处理，并加强退出清理、凭据保护和设置冲突恢复。

title.en: Using Desktop Teams
title.zh: 使用桌面团队

body.en: Set up members, groups, memory, schedules and secret authorizations.
body.zh: 配置成员、群组、记忆、定时任务及密钥授权。

title.en: Connecting messaging Bots
title.zh: 连接消息机器人

body.en: Connect a messaging provider and choose its Team member and routing mode.
body.zh: 连接消息平台，选择对应团队成员及路由方式。

title.en: A persistent local Team
title.zh: 持久化本地团队

body.en: Create members from agent presets, manage groups, open private chats and coordinate bounded handoffs or group rounds. Member identity, conversation history and browser login partitions survive navigation and restart. Background Team work keeps its runtime when a chat is closed.
body.zh: 从智能体预设创建成员、管理群组、打开私聊，并进行有边界的任务交接与群组轮次协作。成员身份、会话历史和浏览器登录分区在切页及重启后保留；关闭聊天显示不会直接终止后台团队运行时。

title.en: Bots connect messaging conversations to members
title.zh: 机器人连接消息会话与团队成员

body.en: Configure messaging channels, including Weixin and Feishu, in Settings. Choose a Team member and receive replies in the originating channel conversation. Saved configuration, connection state and member conversation identity are kept distinct; reconnect and restart restore enabled connections.
body.zh: 在设置中配置微信、飞书等消息渠道，选择团队成员，并在发起消息的渠道会话中接收回复。已保存配置、连接状态和成员会话身份分别管理；重新连接及重启会恢复已启用的连接。

title.en: Team memory and independent schedules
title.zh: 团队记忆与独立定时任务

body.en: Manage member-private, Team and group memory separately. Shared writes require explicit human approval. Optional memory review uses new human messages and preserves fixed guidance. Team schedules save their time zone and occurrence identity, with settings for editing, enabling and reviewing conflicts.
body.zh: 分别管理成员私有、团队及群组记忆，共享写入需要明确人工批准。可选的自动记忆整理只使用新的人类消息并保留固定指导。团队定时任务保存时区和执行身份，可在设置中编辑、启停及处理冲突。

title.en: Member-authorized secrets and attributed usage
title.zh: 成员授权密钥与用量归属

body.en: Store Team secrets in dedicated local slots, authorize individual members, and rotate or revoke them. Approved commands receive values only for that invocation. Exact-value masking covers model, tool, stream, history and extension boundaries; usage is attributed to members, groups and seats.
body.zh: 团队密钥使用专用本地存储，可逐成员授权、轮换及撤销；获批命令只在本次调用中接收密钥值。模型、工具、流式输出、历史及扩展边界执行精确值脱敏，用量可按成员、群组和席位归属。

title.en: Simpler synchronous subagent delegation
title.zh: 更简单的同步子代理委派

body.en: Use spawn_agents for synchronous batches of one to eight independent tasks and read_subagent_result for archived results. Read-only children can run concurrently; writable work shares one writer slot. Profiles, model and effort choices, cancellation, tool restrictions and partial failure archives remain available.
body.zh: 使用 spawn_agents 同步委派 1 至 8 个独立任务，通过 read_subagent_result 读取已归档结果。只读子任务可并行，写入任务共用一个写入席位。继续保留专业配置、模型与推理强度、取消、工具限制及部分失败归档。

title.en: Stable welcome layouts and clearer session controls
title.zh: 稳定的新会话欢迎页与更清晰的会话操作

body.en: New empty sessions retain their centered welcome layout while starting, and model labels remain readable across startup and tab changes. Session status refresh and collapse actions are grouped on the right. Team private chats show the member identity and retain the saved session model.
body.zh: 新建空白会话在启动期间保持居中欢迎布局，启动及切换标签时模型名称保持清晰稳定。会话状态的刷新与折叠操作统一位于右侧。团队私聊明确显示成员身份，并保留已保存的会话模型。

title.en: Preserve complete DeepSeek Messages endpoints
title.zh: 正确保留 DeepSeek Messages 完整接口地址

body.en: Complete /anthropic/messages and /anthropic/v1/messages addresses no longer gain a duplicated Messages suffix. Model settings and selection show friendly names together with routing IDs while discovery, favorites and saved references retain the original IDs.
body.zh: 完整的 /anthropic/messages 和 /anthropic/v1/messages 地址不再重复追加 Messages 路径。模型设置和选择器同时展示友好名称及路由 ID，发现、收藏及已保存引用继续保留原始 ID。

title.en: Bound shutdown waits and recover unfinished cleanup
title.zh: 限制退出等待并恢复未完成清理

body.en: Draft saving is bounded to 15 seconds and controller/Team cleanup waits to 20 seconds. Failures retain unsaved input and allow retry. Cleanup runs outside runtime gates, waits for finalization before releasing storage, and resumes completed failed Team attempts without repeating successful cleanup. Browser cleanup finishes before the window is destroyed.
body.zh: 退出保存草稿最多等待 15 秒，Controller 和团队清理等待最多 20 秒；失败时保留未保存输入并允许重试。清理在运行时锁外执行，最终化后再释放存储；已结束但失败的团队清理可继续恢复，不重复成功清理。浏览器清理完成后才销毁窗口。

title.en: Protect Bot credentials across runtime entry points
title.zh: 跨运行入口保护机器人凭据

body.en: Desktop, CLI/ACP sessions and standalone review protect the Bot credential directory and mask active and migration-backup values before model requests. Runtime owners share a live credential source; unreadable committed snapshots block new outbound requests until repaired. Rotation and deletion keep already observed values masked. Team secret parsing allows bounded cold PowerShell startup while preserving caller cancellation and shorter deadlines.
body.zh: 桌面端、CLI/ACP 会话及独立 review 均保护机器人凭据目录，并在模型请求前脱敏当前凭据及迁移备份中的值。多个运行时共享实时凭据源；已提交凭据快照不可读时阻止新模型请求，直到存储修复。轮换和删除后继续脱敏已观察到的旧值。团队密钥解析为 PowerShell 冷启动保留有限等待，同时遵守调用方取消及更短的截止时间。

title.en: Keep settings drafts through conflicts and saves
title.zh: 设置冲突和保存期间保留草稿

body.en: Schedule conflicts show the latest saved settings while retaining the editor draft. Reviewing an overwrite and saving remain separate actions with revision checks. Secret values, descriptions and member grants are disabled together during save; a failed save restores editing without losing input.
body.zh: 定时任务发生冲突时展示最新已保存设置并保留编辑草稿；审核覆盖和保存保持为两个独立操作，并继续校验版本。密钥值、说明和成员授权在保存时同时禁用，保存失败后恢复编辑且不丢失输入。

title.en: Update custom delegation instructions
title.zh: 更新自定义委派指令

body.en: Replace references to task, read_only_task, parallel_tasks, fleet and complete_subtask with the new synchronous delegation tools. Background, continuation, dependency-graph and nested delegation are removed. Update Desktop, CLI and integrations together when they share the generated command contract.
body.zh: 将自定义指令中的 task、read_only_task、parallel_tasks、fleet 和 complete_subtask 引用改为新的同步委派工具。后台委派、续跑、依赖图及嵌套委派已移除。共享生成命令契约时，请同时更新桌面端、CLI 和集成。

title.en: Review migrated Bot connections
title.zh: 检查迁移后的机器人连接

body.en: Existing Bot preview configurations migrate to stable Team member identities and retain a user-only connections.pre-members.json backup. Check the selected member, permissions, model and connection status after updating. A saved connection is not proof that it connected or delivered a reply.
body.zh: 已有机器人预览配置迁移为稳定的团队成员身份，并保留仅当前用户可读的 connections.pre-members.json 备份。升级后检查所选成员、权限、模型及连接状态；保存连接成功不等于连接或回复投递成功。

title.en: Windows remains unsigned for this release
title.zh: 本版 Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: The maintainer explicitly approved an unsigned Windows 0.0.5 Stable exception. These files have no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warnings. Minisign integrity signatures, provenance and final-package native acceptance remain mandatory. This approval does not cover prereleases or later versions.
body.zh: 维护者已明确批准 Windows 0.0.5 Stable 未签名发布例外。相关文件没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，Windows 可能显示未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。Minisign 完整性签名、来源验证及最终安装包原生验收仍必须完成。此批准不适用于预发布版或后续版本。

title.en: Local secret and messaging boundaries
title.zh: 本地密钥与消息投递边界

body.en: Team secret slots are local unencrypted files accessible to programs running as the same user. Exact-value masking does not prevent encoded or transformed leaks. Messaging delivery can fail or be retried; provider acknowledgement is not a recipient read receipt, and public remote control is not included.
body.zh: 团队密钥槽为本地未加密文件，同一用户运行的程序仍可读取；精确值脱敏不能防止编码或变形泄漏。消息投递可能失败或重试，平台确认不等于接收方已读，本版不包含公共远程控制。

title.en: Consistent Settings and personal agent presets
title.zh: 统一设置体验与个性化智能体预设

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.4 unifies Settings layouts and protects unsaved edits when navigating. Create agent presets directly from the composer, choose a prompt mode, and customize their icons with colors or uploaded images. Provider branding, popup tooltips and release-note links are also corrected. The reported Windows shutdown stall remains under investigation.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.4 统一设置页布局，并在切页时保护未保存的修改。可直接从输入区新建智能体预设、选择提示词模式，并用颜色或上传图片自定义图标。同时修复服务商品牌图标、弹出菜单提示和发布说明链接。已报告的 Windows 退出卡住问题仍在排查。

title.en: Settings keep your edits safe
title.zh: 设置切页保护未保存修改

body.en: All 20 Settings pages share consistent headings, back navigation, spacing, action bars and feedback. When leaving an editor, keep editing, discard changes, or save before continuing. Failed saves retain the draft, and model dialogs apply their edits before the parent connection is saved. Installation, connection and feedback actions still require explicit submission.
body.zh: 全部 20 个设置主页统一标题、返回入口、间距、操作栏和状态反馈。离开编辑器时可继续编辑、放弃更改或保存后继续；保存失败保留草稿，模型弹窗先应用修改再保存父级连接。安装、连接和发送反馈仍需明确提交。

title.en: Create and personalize agent presets
title.zh: 快速创建个性化智能体预设

body.en: Open New agent preset from the composer menu. Names suggest valid, collision-free IDs until you edit the ID yourself. Choose a built-in icon and color, randomize them, or upload and crop a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. The same icon appears in the editor, preset list and composer picker.
body.zh: 从输入区预设菜单直接新建智能体预设。名称会自动建议合法且不冲突的 ID，手动编辑 ID 后停止跟随名称。可选择内置图标及颜色、随机组合，或上传并裁剪 PNG、JPEG、WebP 图片；编辑器、预设列表与输入区选择器显示同一图标。

title.en: Three clear preset prompt modes
title.zh: 三种明确的预设提示词模式

body.en: Choose to extend default instructions, replace coding instructions, or provide the complete system prompt. The editor explains the selected mode and validates its required body. Runtime context moves into Advanced settings, while tool restrictions and existing prompt semantics are preserved.
body.zh: 明确选择扩展默认指令、替换编程指令或提供完整系统提示词。编辑器说明所选模式并校验必要正文；运行时上下文移入高级设置，工具限制及已有提示词语义保持兼容。

title.en: Readable Settings at smaller window sizes
title.zh: 窄窗口下的设置页更易用

body.en: Cards retain space around labels and controls, navigation stays reachable, long paths and dates wrap, and theme preview controls fit narrow windows. Loading failures now stop loading and offer retry instead of appearing as empty results.
body.zh: 卡片文字与控件保留两侧留白，导航保持可达，长路径与日期可换行，主题预览控件适配窄窗口。加载失败会停止加载并提供重试，不再伪装成空列表。

title.en: Magpie is easier to find
title.zh: 更容易找到 Magpie

body.en: Magpie appears third in the Add Provider catalog, after DeepSeek and OpenCode, while the remaining brands keep their relative order.
body.zh: 添加模型服务时，Magpie 位于 DeepSeek、OpenCode 之后的第三位，其他品牌的相对顺序保持不变。

title.en: Provider icons keep their brand identity
title.zh: 服务商图标保持品牌身份

body.en: Generated or renamed connections and model rows retain the preset brand instead of showing a protocol or upstream model vendor's icon. GMI Cloud and Xiaomi MiMo artwork is included; brands without artwork keep their monograms.
body.zh: 自动生成或重命名的连接及模型行保留预设品牌，不再误用协议或上游模型厂商的图标。补齐 GMI Cloud 与小米 MiMo 图标；没有图稿的品牌继续显示首字母。

title.en: Tooltips no longer cover open menus
title.zh: 提示气泡不再覆盖已展开菜单

body.en: Preset, project and session menus hide their trigger's tooltip while expanded, including delayed hover and focus callbacks. Menu content no longer reopens the trigger's help when it receives focus.
body.zh: 预设、项目和会话菜单展开时隐藏触发按钮的提示气泡，包括延迟的悬停与焦点回调；菜单内容获得焦点时也不会重新打开提示。

title.en: Release notes open the latest Desktop release
title.zh: 发布说明打开最新桌面版本

body.en: About's Open on web action and newly created heartbeat update suggestions use the latest Desktop release URL instead of an incomplete tag URL that returned 404.
body.zh: 关于页的在网页查看及新建心跳更新建议使用最新桌面版发布链接，不再打开返回 404 的不完整标签地址。

title.en: Verify official update packages
title.zh: 校验官方更新包

body.en: Desktop packages must pass Minisign integrity and provenance verification, macOS signing and notarization, and the Windows Authenticode policy for this version. Use the official download links and retain package verification when updating.
body.zh: 桌面安装包须通过 Minisign 完整性及来源验证、macOS 签名与公证，以及适用于本版本的 Windows Authenticode 策略。请使用官方下载链接，并在更新时保留安装包校验。

title.en: Update before sharing image or color presets
title.zh: 共享图片或彩色预设前先升级

body.en: Custom icons add optional icon-image and icon-color YAML fields. Update older Desktop and CLI installations before sharing these presets; older versions reject unfamiliar fields. Glyph-only presets remain compatible, and display metadata does not change runtime fingerprints or provider prompts.
body.zh: 自定义图标新增可选的 icon-image、icon-color YAML 字段。共享此类预设前请先升级旧桌面端和 CLI，旧版会拒绝未知字段。仅用内置图标的预设保持兼容，显示元数据不会改变运行时指纹或供应商提示词。

title.en: Windows remains unsigned for this release
title.zh: 本版 Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: The maintainer explicitly approved an unsigned Windows 0.0.4 exception. These files have no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warnings. Minisign integrity signatures, provenance and final-package native acceptance remain mandatory. This approval does not cover later versions.
body.zh: 维护者已明确批准 Windows 0.0.4 未签名发布例外。相关文件没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，Windows 可能显示未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。Minisign 完整性签名、来源验证及最终安装包原生验收仍必须完成。此批准不适用于后续版本。

title.en: Reported Windows shutdown stall remains under investigation
title.zh: Windows 退出卡住的报告仍在排查

body.en: The report of shutdown stopping at shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background remains open. This release's Settings and preset improvements do not resolve it. If affected, attach service.log and service.log.1 from %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs to issue #126, retaining the desktop: shutdown step entries.
body.zh: 退出停在 shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background 的报告仍未关闭，本版设置和预设改进不代表已解决该问题。如遇到，请向 issue #126 附上 %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs 下的 service.log 与 service.log.1，并保留 desktop: shutdown step 记录。

title.en: Conversation status, Magpie models and more reliable updates
title.zh: 会话状态面板、Magpie 模型与更可靠的更新

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.3 adds a conversation status panel, Magpie gateway model discovery, per-model native search, and easier preset editing. It fixes sessions appearing disconnected, restores the conversation width setting, and improves update downloads and Settings. The bilingual official website is now available. Windows 0.0.3 remains unsigned, and the reported shutdown stall remains under investigation.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.3 新增会话状态面板、Magpie 网关模型发现、按模型配置原生搜索，以及更方便的预设编辑。修复会话显示连接中断和会话宽度设置不生效的问题，并改进更新下载与设置页。中英双语官网现已上线。Windows 0.0.3 仍未代码签名，已报告的退出卡住问题仍在排查。

title.en: Conversation status in one panel
title.zh: 在一个面板中查看会话状态

body.en: Expand the status pill at the top right of the chat to inspect the workspace and Git changes, Goal progress, plan and todos, background commands, workflows and subagents. Read background output and child conversations, or cancel a selected subagent without stopping its parent.
body.zh: 展开聊天区右上角的状态按钮，查看工作区与 Git 变更、Goal 进度、计划与待办、后台命令、工作流和子智能体。可以查看后台输出和子会话，或取消指定子智能体而不停止父会话。

title.en: Magpie gateway models
title.zh: 接入 Magpie 网关模型

body.en: A new Magpie provider preset connects to the local gateway. Adding it in Desktop fetches and enables the gateway's configured models, keeping their display names while preserving the model IDs used for routing. Start Magpie and configure its providers first.
body.zh: 新增 Magpie 服务商预设，可连接本机网关。在桌面端添加连接时会获取并启用网关中已配置的模型，显示模型名称并保留实际路由使用的模型 ID。使用前请先启动 Magpie 并配置其中的服务商。

title.en: Native search per model
title.zh: 按模型设置原生搜索

body.en: Edit a model to turn native search on or off for that model only. Models you leave alone inherit the connection setting. The option is available on the Anthropic and Responses protocols, and on official DeepSeek connections. Other Chat Completions connections have no native search, so it stays disabled there.
body.zh: 在编辑模型时可以只为该模型开关原生搜索，未设置的模型沿用连接级配置。Anthropic、Responses 协议和官方 DeepSeek 连接可用此选项；其他 Chat Completions 连接没有原生搜索，选项保持禁用。

title.en: Preset tool picker and icons
title.zh: 预设工具选择器与图标

body.en: Choose built-in tools and MCP servers from a grouped, searchable list, or add custom tool names and patterns. Selected tools appear as removable chips. Choose an optional preset icon that also appears in the composer picker; card descriptions and editor hints now align consistently.
body.zh: 在可搜索的分组列表中选择内置工具和 MCP 服务，也可添加自定义工具名称与匹配模式；已选工具显示为可移除标签。预设可选配图标，并同步显示在输入区选择器中；卡片说明与编辑提示的对齐也已修复。

title.en: Bilingual official website
title.zh: 中英双语官网

body.en: The official website at https://deepzora.app now offers Chinese and English pages with desktop downloads. Release delivery verifies the R2 download mirror before updating the website's version and download links.
body.zh: 官网 https://deepzora.app 现提供中文和英文页面及桌面端下载。发布流程在验证 R2 下载镜像后，再更新官网版本和下载链接。

title.en: Verified mirror downloads for updates
title.zh: 通过验证的镜像下载更新

body.en: The updater prefers the R2 mirror and falls back to GitHub when needed, verifying downloaded files against the release's expected integrity information.
body.zh: 自动更新优先使用 R2 镜像，必要时回退到 GitHub，并依据目标版本的完整性信息校验下载文件。

title.en: One surface across Settings
title.zh: 设置页使用统一界面

body.en: The sidebar, navigation and content area now share one background, separated by a single divider, and page sections no longer sit on white blocks.
body.zh: 侧边栏、导航和内容区现在使用同一背景，仅以一条分隔线区分，页面分区也不再显示为白色色块。

title.en: Quieter usage heatmap
title.zh: 用量热力图更柔和

body.en: Days without usage now use a neutral color, so an empty heatmap no longer looks like activity.
body.zh: 没有用量的日期现在使用中性色，空白热力图不再看起来像有活动记录。

title.en: Full-width feedback box
title.zh: 反馈输入框占满整行

body.en: The feedback field in Settings now spans the full row at every window width.
body.zh: 设置中的反馈输入框在任意窗口宽度下都会占满整行。

title.en: Dependency updates
title.zh: 依赖更新

body.en: Updated Go and desktop dependencies, including `golang.org/x/net`, `modernc.org/sqlite`, Vite and KaTeX.
body.zh: 更新了 Go 和桌面端依赖，包括 `golang.org/x/net`、`modernc.org/sqlite`、Vite 和 KaTeX。

title.en: New sessions no longer disconnect every workspace
title.zh: 新会话不再导致所有工作区显示断连

body.en: Creating a session, cancelling a turn, or entering recovery no longer makes one session's incomplete runtime state mark all workspaces as disconnected and disable their inputs. The separately reported shutdown stall is not fixed by this change.
body.zh: 创建会话、取消一轮对话或进入恢复状态时，不再因单个会话的运行状态不完整而让所有工作区显示连接中断并禁用输入框。另行报告的退出卡住问题不属于本次修复范围。

title.en: Conversation width applies to the transcript
title.zh: 会话宽度设置对聊天内容生效

body.en: The standard and full-width settings now resize the conversation transcript as well as the composer. Collapsing the sidebar can widen the chat column again.
body.zh: 标准和全宽设置现在会同时调整聊天内容与输入区宽度，折叠侧边栏后聊天列也能相应变宽。

title.en: Quieter automatic update checks
title.zh: 自动检查更新减少无效报错

body.en: Temporary network failures during startup or focus-triggered update checks no longer show an update-failed banner. Automatic checks retry after 15 minutes; checks you start manually still report failures.
body.zh: 启动或窗口重新获得焦点时，自动检查更新遇到临时网络故障不再弹出更新失败提示，并会在 15 分钟后重试；手动检查仍会报告失败。

title.en: No recovery warning during normal submission
title.zh: 正常发送时不再闪现恢复警告

body.en: Submitting a message normally no longer briefly displays a recovery warning while the session state updates.
body.zh: 正常提交消息时，会话状态更新期间不再短暂显示恢复警告。

title.en: Settings work with no tab open
title.zh: 未打开标签页时也能修改设置

body.en: Settings that rebuild the runtime no longer fail with `no active tab` when nothing is open. They now save and apply to the next tab. Removing a plugin works in the same state.
body.zh: 未打开任何内容时，需要重建运行时的设置不再报 `no active tab` 错误，而是保存后在下一个标签页生效。此状态下卸载插件同样可用。

title.en: More time for Git Bash detection
title.zh: 放宽 Git Bash 检测时间

body.en: On Windows, bash and git probes now wait up to 15 seconds instead of 3, so a slow first launch is less likely to be reported as not installed.
body.zh: Windows 上的 bash 和 git 探测现在最多等待 15 秒（原为 3 秒），首次启动较慢时更不容易被误报为未安装。

title.en: New optional model setting
title.zh: 新增可选模型配置

body.en: `model_overrides.<model>.web_search` is optional. Existing configurations behave the same until you set it.
body.zh: `model_overrides.<model>.web_search` 为可选项。未设置时，现有配置的行为不变。

title.en: Reported Windows shutdown stall remains under investigation
title.zh: Windows 退出卡住的报告仍在排查

body.en: A Windows report describes shutdown stopping at `shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background`. The issue has not been reproduced locally and is not resolved by the session-state fix. If it occurs, attach service.log and service.log.1 from %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs to [issue #126](https://github.com/SivanCola/deepzora/issues/126), including the `desktop: shutdown step` entries.
body.zh: 已有 Windows 报告显示退出停在 `shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background`。该问题尚未在本地复现，会话状态修复不代表已解决退出问题。如遇到，请在 [issue #126](https://github.com/SivanCola/deepzora/issues/126) 附上 %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs 下的 service.log 与 service.log.1，保留其中的 `desktop: shutdown step` 记录。

title.en: Windows still unsigned
title.zh: Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: Windows 0.0.3 has no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Desktop download and payload integrity signatures remain required. This is a version-specific exception approved by the maintainer.
body.zh: Windows 0.0.3 没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，可能出现未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。桌面下载及载荷完整性签名仍须校验。本例外仅限该版本，由维护者批准。

title.en: Native search on unverified endpoints
title.zh: 未验证端点上的原生搜索

body.en: Compatible endpoints that Deepzora has not verified can be opted in, but requests may fail if the endpoint does not support native search. Turn the option off for that model if this happens.
body.zh: 尚未经 Deepzora 验证的兼容端点也可以手动开启，但如果端点不支持原生搜索，请求可能失败。遇到这种情况时，请为该模型关闭此选项。

title.en: Focused local desktop and CLI
title.zh: 专注本地的桌面端与 CLI

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.2 narrows the product to the CLI, the desktop app and ACP. SSH remote workspaces, deepzora serve and session takeover are removed. This release adds session agent presets and native attachments, keeps the sidebar current while you work, and fixes issues found in live CLI runs. Sessions created by 0.0.1 open and continue unchanged. Windows 0.0.2 is still distributed without Authenticode signing.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.2 将产品收敛为 CLI、桌面端和 ACP，移除 SSH 远程工作区、deepzora serve 和会话接管。本版新增会话智能体预设与原生附件，侧边栏随工作实时更新，并修复真实 CLI 运行中发现的问题。0.0.1 创建的会话可直接打开并继续。Windows 0.0.2 仍未提供 Authenticode 代码签名。

title.en: Session agent presets
title.zh: 会话智能体预设

body.en: Write reusable agent definitions in user or project Markdown, pick one before the first turn, and reopen a session against the latest saved definition. Tool allowlists are enforced separately from permission approval.
body.zh: 在用户或项目 Markdown 中编写可复用的智能体定义，首轮前选择，重新打开会话时使用最新保存的定义。工具白名单独立于权限审批强制执行。

title.en: A sidebar that keeps up
title.zh: 实时更新的侧边栏

body.en: New sessions appear in the sidebar as soon as you send, and an untitled session takes its first message as its name in both the sidebar and the title bar.
body.zh: 发送后新会话立即出现在侧边栏；未命名会话在侧边栏和标题栏中都以首条消息作为名称。

title.en: Native attachments
title.zh: 原生附件

body.en: Reference local files natively and stream large attachments instead of pasting their contents.
body.zh: 可原生引用本地文件，大附件以流式传输，无需粘贴内容。

title.en: Piped input with a prompt
title.zh: 管道输入与提示词并用

body.en: `git diff | deepzora -p "review this"` now passes the piped text to the model after the prompt. A pipe that stays silent for 2 seconds is ignored, so callers that leave stdin open do not hang.
body.zh: `git diff | deepzora -p "review this"` 现在会把管道内容附在提示词之后发给模型；2 秒内无数据的管道会被忽略，保持 stdin 打开的调用方不会卡住。

title.en: Clearer diagnostics and flags
title.zh: 更清晰的诊断与参数

body.en: `doctor` reports the per-project session store, the missing-key error names the `.env` file and `deepzora setup`, `run` accepts `-r` for `--resume`, and invalid `--max-steps` or `--effort` values exit with code 2.
body.zh: `doctor` 显示按项目划分的会话目录；缺少密钥时提示 `.env` 路径和 `deepzora setup`；`run` 支持 `-r` 作为 `--resume` 简写；无效的 `--max-steps` 或 `--effort` 以退出码 2 结束。

title.en: Sessions in use elsewhere open read-only
title.zh: 被占用的会话以只读方式打开

body.en: Opening a session that another Deepzora process is writing now shows its history read-only instead of failing.
body.zh: 打开正被另一个 Deepzora 进程写入的会话时，现在以只读方式显示历史，而不是打开失败。

title.en: Title bar name for new sessions
title.zh: 新会话的标题栏名称

body.en: The title bar no longer stays on "New session" after the first message is saved.
body.zh: 首条消息保存后，标题栏不再停留在“新的会话”。

title.en: Remote and Serve features removed
title.zh: 远程与 Serve 功能已移除

body.en: SSH remote workspaces, `deepzora serve`, `deepzora remote`, `deepzora web`, `/remote`, `/takeover` and `--takeover` are gone. Leftover `[remote]` and `[serve]` config sections are ignored. Local sessions, the CLI, the desktop app and ACP are unaffected.
body.zh: SSH 远程工作区、`deepzora serve`、`deepzora remote`、`deepzora web`、`/remote`、`/takeover` 和 `--takeover` 已移除。配置中残留的 `[remote]`、`[serve]` 段会被忽略。本地会话、CLI、桌面端和 ACP 不受影响。

title.en: 0.0.1 sessions carry over
title.zh: 0.0.1 会话可直接沿用

body.en: Sessions and desktop data created by 0.0.1 open, show their history and continue in 0.0.2 without migration.
body.zh: 0.0.1 创建的会话和桌面数据无需迁移，在 0.0.2 中可直接打开、查看历史并继续对话。

title.en: Windows still unsigned
title.zh: Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: Windows 0.0.2 has no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Desktop download and payload integrity signatures remain required. This is a version-specific exception approved by the maintainer.
body.zh: Windows 0.0.2 没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，可能出现未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。桌面下载及载荷完整性签名仍须校验。本例外仅限该版本，由维护者批准。

title.en: First public version
title.zh: 首个公开版本

summary.en: The first Deepzora baseline brings the current CLI, Electron desktop and Serve service into independent release channels, with documented signing and privacy policies. Windows v0.0.1 is distributed without Authenticode signing.
summary.zh: Deepzora 首版提供当前 CLI、Electron 桌面端和 Serve 服务，采用独立发布渠道并公开签名与隐私政策。Windows v0.0.1 暂不提供 Authenticode 代码签名。

title.en: One current contract
title.zh: 统一当前契约

body.en: Current session storage, formal-session composer state, scoped command receipts, and the Deepzora remote baseline are the supported formats.
body.zh: 仅支持当前会话存储、正式会话输入状态、带作用域回执的命令和 Deepzora 远程基线。

title.en: Unsigned Windows first release
title.zh: Windows 首版暂未代码签名

body.en: Windows v0.0.1 has no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may display an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Desktop download and payload integrity signatures remain required. This is a version-specific exception; SignPath approval is pending.
body.zh: Windows v0.0.1 没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，可能出现未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。桌面下载及载荷完整性签名仍须校验。本次例外仅限该版本，SignPath 授权仍待审核。

title.en: Current formats only
title.zh: 仅支持当前数据格式

body.en: This independent baseline does not migrate historical Reasonix credentials, storage formats or desktop interfaces. Review the privacy policy before configuring providers, tools or optional diagnostic collectors.
body.zh: 独立首版不迁移 Reasonix 历史凭据、存储格式或旧桌面接口。配置模型、工具及可选诊断接收端前，请查看隐私政策。
